deviations.what: useFormReset(element, reset, show) attaches observeFieldValue presence only when the element is an input, textarea or select; ToggleGroup keeps passing its first radio / hidden probe (not the fieldset) so the presence attribute stays where it was
deviations.why: observeFieldValue accepts only native value elements; same reset timing and rendered result

deviations.what: Rating (Vue) also writes its radios back after a reset (show) and keeps defaultValue 0 as its own declared default; numberProps.formatValue is not spread into Rating
deviations.why: convention native-form-reset covers every control; Rating is not specified to gain formatValue or lose its default

deviations.what: ToggleGroup and MultiSelect legends use optionalText/needText instead of rootLabel
deviations.why: rootLabel returns the aria-label text, which would render a legend; the spec DOM (NAME-02) requires no legend when only aria-label is given

deviations.what: the MultiSelect filter input keeps form="{form}" (name stays only on the hidden inputs)
deviations.why: the filter input owns the custom validity and is the element observeFormReset follows; without it a MultiSelect associated with an external form through `form` was not reset (RESET-08)

deviations.what: the watchEffects that set the custom validity of Combobox, TagInput and MultiSelect run with flush 'post'
deviations.why: the cleared state must read validity after the input shows the new value (native required on Combobox); it also sets the validity right after mount

deviations.what: PinInput emits `complete` only when the value changed and is complete
deviations.why: one more typed character into a full code keeps the previous value and must notify nothing (PININPUT-02)

deviations.what: a read-only FileDropzone also prevents Space and Enter keydown on the file input
deviations.why: RO-02 asks Space to be default-prevented; the click guard alone covers the chooser in browsers
